}}'''Exploration Reports''' are in-universe text excerpts unlocked through [[Exploration Progress]] in each [[Region]].

==Overview==
Each Region, except [[Chronorift Metropolis]], has 2 unlockable Exploration Reports, which the player can access upon reaching 50% and 100% completion in the region. Exploration Reports can be viewed through selecting the book icon on any Region's Exploration Progress menu.
